blocks.text: Carbohydrates ko “saccharides” bhi kehte hain (Latin lafz “saccharum” ka matlab sugar hai), aur isi naam par inhein teen groups mein baanta jata hai: 1. monosaccharides, 2. disaccharides, aur 3. polysaccharides.

Monosaccharides (simple sugars) sirf ek sugar molecule se bane hote hain. Yeh pani mein aasani se hal ho jate hain. In mein 3 se 7 carbon atoms ho sakte hain, aur carbon atoms ki tadaad ke hisaab se inhein mazeed subgroups mein baanta jata hai. Pentoses (5 carbon) aur hexoses (6 carbon) sab se aam hain aur har jandar mein milte hain. Hexoses energy storage (tawanai jama karne) mein markazi kirdar ada karte hain. Energy jama karne wala sab se bunyadi molecule glucose hai, jis mein energy rakhne wale saat C-H bonds hain. Is ka formula C₆H₁₂O₆ ya (CH₂O)₆ hai.

blocks.text: Jin molecules mein atoms ki tadaad ek jaisi ho (molecular formula ek ho) magar atoms ki tarteeb (arrangement) alag ho (structural formula alag ho), unhein ek doosre ke isomers kehte hain. Maslan sirf glucose ka formula C₆H₁₂O₆ nahin; fructose aur galactose ka molecular formula bhi yehi hai, magar un ke structural formulas alag hain. Structure aur rukh (orientation) ke yeh farq polymers banne mein bohat aham asar rakhte hain.

blocks.alt: Teen khuli-zanjeer (Fischer) formulas, unwan Aldose, Ketose, Aldose: glucose (carbon 1 par C=O), fructose (carbon 2 par C=O) aur galactose (carbon 1 par C=O). C=O groups roshan hain, aur glucose aur galactose ke carbon 4 par H aur OH, jo ulte hain, roshan hain. Labels: Aldose, Ketose, Glucose, Fructose, Galactose.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.12: Glucose ke structural aur stereoisomers (kitab ki Figure 4.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Fructose mein double bond wala oxygen zanjeer ke aakhri carbon ki bajaye andar wale carbon (number 2) se jura hai. Yani glucose aur fructose structural isomers hain. Glucose aur galactose mein sirf carbon number 4 par ek hydroxyl (OH) group ka rukh (orientation) alag hai (Figure 4.12). Matlab glucose aur galactose stereoisomers hain.

blocks.alt: Khuli-zanjeer ribose: upar H-C=O, phir H-C-OH ki ikaiyan, aur neeche H (C1 aldehyde se C5 tak).
blocks.caption: Figure 4.13: Ribose ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Aam paanch carbon wali (pentose) sugars mein ribose aur deoxyribose (jo nucleic acids aur ATP mein milti hain) aur ribulose (jo photosynthesis mein precursor yani shuruati maadda hai) shamil hain.
